pmo.actionsDesc: Every open action in the workspace, whether or not anything is wrong with it. The buckets beneath are the triage; this is the register.
pmo.actionsEmptyHint: Anything captured as an action, and still open, is listed here on its own.
pmo.actionsOwnDesc: The PMO’s own follow-up list, not the captured register above — up to two owners on a line, and a due date only where one was promised.
pmo.actionsOwnEmptyHint: These are the lines a huddle writes down: what has to happen, who is doing it, and by when if anybody said.
pmo.blankIsNobody: Leave it blank if nobody has said — blank is not zero.
pmo.commitmentsDesc: What this workspace has promised, and by when. Each one is read against the same stage records the map shows, so this page and the map cannot disagree about how far a commitment has got.
pmo.deleteBody: The row goes for everybody who reads this workspace, and it cannot be undone.
pmo.deliveryDesc: One row per organization on the onboarding ladder: the stage it has reached, how much of its use case set is recorded, and who is accountable for it. This is the map’s portfolio, read as a list.
pmo.deliveryEmptyHint: This section reads the hierarchy under Settings › Structure. Nothing has been recorded there yet.
pmo.emptyHint: This page fills itself in as work is recorded. Nothing below is hidden — there is simply nothing to show.
pmo.errMeasure: A key result needs a starting value and a target, and both have to be numbers.
pmo.errMoney: That is not an amount. Leave it blank if there is no figure to record.
pmo.errName: A name is needed before this can be saved.
pmo.errPct: A percentage is a whole number from 0 to 100 — or blank, if nobody has said.
pmo.errProject: Revenue belongs to a project. Choose the one this quarter is for.
pmo.errSummary: Say what this is before saving it.
pmo.errTarget: A target equal to the starting value is a measure that cannot move. Give it somewhere to go.
pmo.errTitle: A title is needed before this can be saved.
pmo.errYear: A year is four digits between 2000 and 2100.
pmo.followDesc: The same buckets the attention list uses, in the same order, and every item lands in exactly one of them.
pmo.initEmptyHint: A commitment is made on an organization’s panel in the map — a stage, a count and the date it is promised for.
pmo.initEmptyHint2: An initiative is lighter than a project and runs on its own four steps, from planning through to spreading what was learned.
pmo.initError: The commitments could not be read
pmo.initErrorHint: This part of the workspace has not been set up in the database yet. Nothing you have recorded is missing — there is simply nothing here to read.
pmo.initPending: Not there yet — this one either arrives or it does not, so there is no fraction to show.
pmo.initiativesDesc: Lighter than a project and on its own four steps: planning, execution, evaluation, then spreading what was learned.
pmo.jiraKeyHint: The key on its own, such as NPH-123. The link is built from the site address in Settings, so moving Atlassian does not break it.

lateMeasured.one: Judged against one organization whose stage carries an expected duration.
lateMeasured.other: Judged against {count} organizations whose stage carries an expected duration.

pmo.lateNoClock: No organization's stage was put there by a person, so there is nothing to measure the rungs against.
pmo.lateNoClockHint: The rungs do carry expected durations. What is missing is somebody moving an organization onto one — every stage recorded here was written by an import, and an import's timestamp says when the import ran, not how long the work has taken.
pmo.lateNoExpectationHint: Nobody is late because nobody can be: give a stage an expected duration and this becomes a real count.
pmo.lateNoOrganizations: No organization has been recorded yet
pmo.lateNoOrganizationsHint: Add them under Settings › Structure and this section starts answering for them.

lateNoStage.one: The one organization here has no stage recorded.
lateNoStage.other: None of the {count} organizations here has a stage recorded.

pmo.lateNoStageHint: Until somebody says where an organization has got to, there is no clock for it to be late against.
pmo.lateOneClock: Every organization’s stage was recorded on ⁨{date}⁩, so this counts days since then rather than time spent on a rung.
pmo.lateTooEarly: No organization has been on its stage long enough to be late yet
pmo.lateTooEarlyHint: The longest anyone has stood on their current stage is ⁨{days}⁩.
pmo.needsMigration: This section needs a setup step
pmo.needsMigrationHint: The portfolio tables have not been created in this workspace yet. Until they are, there is nothing here to show — which is different from having no projects.
pmo.noProgress: Nobody has recorded progress on this yet
pmo.okrNoKeyResults: No key results yet, so there is nothing to measure
pmo.okrsDesc: Objectives and the measurable results that say whether they were met. Progress is read off the key results and is never typed in.
pmo.okrsEmptyHint: An objective is what you are trying to achieve; its key results are the measurable things that say whether you did.
pmo.overviewDesc: The whole workspace as it stands right now. Only the two charts are windowed, and each names its own range.
pmo.periodHint: Whatever you call the window — 2026, H1 2026, Q3.
pmo.projNoCoverage: No use case has been recorded against this organization yet.

projRecorded.one: Only one of these use cases has anything recorded against it.
projRecorded.other: Only {count} of these use cases have anything recorded against them.

pmo.projectsDesc: The programme’s own projects — each with a manager, a budget, dates and how far it has actually got against where it was meant to be.
pmo.projectsEmptyHint: A project is one of the programme’s own pieces of work — a manager, a budget, dates and a lifecycle. These are not the organizations on the map; those are under Delivery.
pmo.readingHint: Read off the priority somebody set and the health the clock reports. It is not a stored score and nothing is ranked by it.
pmo.revenueDesc: Planned and achieved by quarter, per project, in Saudi riyals.
pmo.revenueEmptyHint: Revenue is entered per project per quarter, so the year adds up without anything being counted twice.
pmo.revenueNeedsProject: Revenue is recorded against a project, so add a project before a quarter.
pmo.riskEmptyHint: Anything captured as this type, and still open, appears here on its own.
pmo.risksDesc: Open issues and open escalations. Two tables because they are read differently — one record behind both, told apart by the type somebody chose.
pmo.risksOwnDesc: Risks and challenges on the programme itself. One record behind both, told apart by the word somebody chose — and ungraded stays ungraded rather than becoming low.
pmo.risksOwnEmptyHint: A risk is what might go wrong; a challenge is what already is. Both take a level, an impact and what is being done about it.
pmo.slaNone: Nothing that finished in this window carried a service deadline, so there is no rate to report.
pmo.slaRate: ⁨{met}⁩ of ⁨{measured}⁩ finished inside the deadline we had set.

slaUnmeasured.one: One more finished with no deadline recorded, and is in neither half.
slaUnmeasured.other: {count} more finished with no deadline recorded, and are in neither half.

pmo.startValueHint: Where the measure stood when the commitment was made. Without it, 40 rising to 60 against a target of 100 reads as 60% done when it is 33%.
pmo.subtitle: Delivery, what is waiting on somebody, and what is going wrong. Every number below is read off what this workspace holds — where it holds nothing, it says so rather than showing a zero.
pmo.title: PMO dashboard
